Answer: E
Reason: Figure 1a shows a large left-sided mediastinal mass with associated left lower lobe collapse/consolidation, while Figure 1b demonstrates near-complete resolution of the mass and re-expansion of the lung with clear fields. This dramatic radiographic improvement following treatment is characteristic of the rapid response seen in chemosensitive malignancies like non-Hodgkin's lymphoma.
